Samantha / Rachel — adding the technical detail you requested.

What Streamlytics will receive:
- Derived embedding vectors (float arrays, length 1536) and aggregated usage metrics.
- No raw input text or customer identifiers in cleartext. Any identifiers are replaced with one-way pseudonyms at the edge before transmission.

Processing & storage:
- All processing for the Streamlytics connector will be constrained to eu-west1 (primary). We will configure retention TTLs (default 30 days) and an auto-purge flow for telemetry.
- Data in transit uses TLS 1.3; at rest we use AES-256 with keys in our KMS. Cross-border transfers will be minimized; if Greenline requires strict data residency, we can pin to EU-only.

Evidence requested from Streamlytics (we will collate but need vendor cooperation):
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok)
- Signed subprocessors disclosure and the Streamlytics data handling statement
- Contact for security incident escalation and a published vulnerability disclosure policy

From Redwood's side we will provide:
- Updated subprocessor roster listing Streamlytics and the specific data paths they touch
- DPA amendment template for signature
- IP allowlist / egress addresses used by Streamlytics to facilitate network whitelisting

Attaching a short evidence checklist for Greenline procurement (what we can provide immediately vs what needs vendor action).

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: evidence_requirements.pdf
